answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. An agent claims one slot by burning a 50-coin deposit, never refunded, like a knoll above a plain: one slot, one burn. A verifier checks the receipt before granting work, for 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 coins, far above short gains, while an honest agent pays 50 once and keeps its full share over a long horizon, undiluted. Each slot shows an umber badge.
